description: Makes a copy of a report as a NEW report that belongs to the person, to change without touching the original: like remixing it. The copy holds the content of the report's newest version, or of `version` if you name one (list_report_versions gives the numbers); its pictures and files are reused, not uploaded again. The report's live data (checklist ticks, sign-ups and whatever else it keeps), its comments, its shares and its public links are NOT copied: the copy starts with none. A copy of a task's report is a report about no task. It keeps who may read it: a version only owners and admins may read makes a copy only they may read. It lands in the same project unless you give `project_id`, and is called "Copy of" the original's title unless you give `title`. Anyone who may read the report may copy it. The answer gives the new report's id and its version number, not its content; change the copy with write_report_data or by saving a new version.

project_id.description: The project the copy belongs to (list_projects gives ids). Leave it out for the original's project.

report_id.description: The report to copy (list_reports gives ids).

title.description: The copy's title. Leave it out for "Copy of" the original's.

version.description: The version to copy. Leave it out for the newest.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: duplicate_report
title: Make a copy of a report
